can_say: The cohort contains 7.344M distinct exact-linked phase cells across 73 physical screens.
cannot_say: Screen-level reporter observations are not independent cells when multiple reporters are acquired in one screen.
positive_interpretation: The paired spectrum makes the two screen-level count units auditable.
negative_interpretation: A zero phase-to-reporter gap in one-reporter screens is expected by design.

can_say: The atlas contains 9.996M exact-linked reporter observations across 99 acquired reporter-screen assays.
cannot_say: Unequal assay coverage does not establish unequal biological importance or recoverability.
positive_interpretation: The assay spectrum exposes the observed coverage range and locates recurring manuscript examples.
negative_interpretation: The assay spectrum is descriptive and contains no inferential comparison.

can_say: Reporter-specific targets contain 1,604 endpoints in blocks of 20-72 dimensions.
cannot_say: The target schema does not imply equal endpoint reliability or predictability.
positive_interpretation: The compact baseline preserves the complete frozen target accounting.
negative_interpretation: Endpoint dimensionality alone cannot establish measurement sufficiency.
